name: Browser Policies Modified via Registry
description: Detects the creation or modification of registry keys that enforce policies on Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge. This is a common method for adversaries to force-install extensions or alter browser behavior.

action.description: A browser policy was set or modified in the registry. SIEM should inspect the policy being enforced and the responsible process.

operational_usage: This feature is a strong indicator of browser tampering. Legitimate changes are typically made by Group Policy (gpupdate.exe) or enterprise management solutions. Any other process, especially from a user context, is highly suspicious.
false_positive: Legitimate changes by system administrators or enterprise software are expected. Focus should be on the context of the change.
